info.name: Customer Care API - Full Test Suite
info.description:
Run the whole collection in order (Runner -> Run collection). Each folder depends on the previous one.

TOKENS:

- userToken: customer right after register (role USER)
    
- customerToken: customer after the admin upgraded them (role CUSTOMER)
    
- adminToken: seeded admin
    
- brokenToken: garbage JWT for 401 tests

request.description:
WHAT IT DOES: Registers a new customer. Username/email are generated randomly in the pre-request script so the collection can be re-run.

AUTH: Public (no token).

POSSIBLE ERRORS:
- 400 - validation failed (email format, password < 8, username not letters-only 5-30)
- 400/409 - username or email already used (depends on CreateCustomer)

BUSINESS RULE: new customer gets role USER until an admin upgrades them to CUSTOMER.

WHAT IT DOES: Bean Validation (@Email) must reject the request before reaching the service.

AUTH: Public.

POSSIBLE ERRORS:
- 400 - handled by handleValidation (MethodArgumentNotValidException)

WHAT IT DOES: @Size(min = 8) on password must reject this.

AUTH: Public.

POSSIBLE ERRORS:
- 400 - validation failed

WHAT IT DOES: Username pattern ^[a-zA-Z]{5,30}$ allows letters only.

AUTH: Public.

POSSIBLE ERRORS:
- 400 - validation failed

request.description:
WHAT IT DOES: Logs the customer in and returns a JWT. At this point the role is still USER, so the token is saved as userToken (NOT customerToken).

AUTH: Public.

POSSIBLE ERRORS:
- 401 - wrong password (BadCredentialsException)
- 401 - account disabled (DisabledException)
- 400 - blank/missing fields

WHAT IT DOES: Wrong password must be rejected.

AUTH: Public.

POSSIBLE ERRORS:
- 401 - 'Invalid username or password'

WHAT IT DOES: Unknown username must look the same as a wrong password (no user enumeration).
NOTE: if CustomerDetails throws NoSuchElementException the real answer is 404 (handleNotFound) and this test FAILS. Fix: throw UsernameNotFoundException in CustomerDetails.

AUTH: Public.

POSSIBLE ERRORS:
- 401 - expected
- 404 - current behaviour if NoSuchElementException leaks out (leaks that the user does not exist)
